content:
🎉 Excited to share that I’ve joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC)** — a milestone that feels especially meaningful after working with the CDS Hooks standard since **2017**, from its earliest drafts through multiple releases and real-world implementations.

CDS Hooks has always stood out for its elegant balance of clinical relevance, developer pragmatism, and interoperability rigor — and I’m truly honored to help guide its next chapter. I’m especially energized about advancing adoption, strengthening implementation guidance, improving tooling, and ensuring the standard continues to evolve *with* and *for* the community.

💡 A quick ask:  
✅ If you’re **already using CDS Hooks**, please help others discover your work — add your implementation to the official [CDS Hooks Availability Wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability). Visibility fuels adoption, inspires others, and helps us better understand real-world needs.  
✅ If you’re **not yet using it**, but are exploring clinical decision support, FHIR-based integrations, or scalable point-of-care interventions — I’m available as a **freelance CDS Hooks consultant**. Whether you’re a health system, EHR vendor, startup, or innovation team, I’d love to help you design, implement, or optimize your CDS Hooks integration — from architecture to production readiness.

Grateful to the CDS Hooks community, the existing PMC, and everyone who’s contributed to building something this impactful — one hook at a time. 🪝

#CDSHooks #FHIR #HealthIT #Interoperability #DigitalHealth #HITConsulting #ClinicalDecisionSupport
